original.target_description: Experiment 5: response-time switch versus stay main effect when reading regular words and nonwords. Study/outcome match, but locator does not distinguish the paired F1 and F2 analyses, so target_match remains null.

es.location: Printed p. 56 (PDF p. 7), Experiment 5, Results, RT, right column; Table 5 supplies switch/stay descriptive means.

p.location: Printed p. 56 (PDF p. 7), Experiment 5, Results, RT, right column; Table 5 supplies switch/stay descriptive means.

notes: Only es_value_o and pval_value_o assigned. Experiment 5 is identified by its explicit heading and regular-word/nonword design, not input order or numeric matching. Candidate switch-cost analyses: F1 < 1, printed η² = .002; F2 < 1, printed η² < .001. No choice between these analyses is supported by the supplied locator; candidates retained here rather than assigned to es.value. Metric is printed as η²; no conversion or further metric standardisation made. Neither switch-cost analysis prints a p value or p bound; F < 1 is a test-statistic bound, not a p bound. Nearby p < .001 concerns lexicality, and p > .10 concerns the interaction, so neither was transferred to the switch-cost test. Table 5 gives response-time means and differences rather than an additional inferential switch-cost p. PDF p. 7 rendered and inspected for column layout. All unassigned fields are placeholders.
